investigator.method: Pre-activation implementation-time review (BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01), superseding london-t2-jamboree-02. While building ingestion/jamboree/observation-adapter.mjs against the real, full /upcoming-events/ response (14 cards, the venue's complete current listing, not the prior record's narrower sample), a genuinely useful source-exposed field was characterised fully: every card's own <h4> programme-note text ('Live Music from ...' vs 'Class Runs from ...') deterministically distinguishes Jamboree's real music programme from its recurring dance/art classes. This record documents that finding plus a real Nominatim OSM_ID_LOOKUP coordinate confirmation.

probe_history.reason: Carries forward london-t2-jamboree-02's own probe_history -- retained here as INSUFFICIENT for the new question this record answers (does the full current listing, not a narrower sample, contain non-music records requiring a runtime filter?).

A real, unauthenticated GET to the full /upcoming-events/ page (the same confirmed public data path as london-t2-jamboree-02) was parsed in full. All 14 real current cards were reviewed (evidence/full-listing-review.json): 11 are genuine live-music events (own h4 text states 'Live Music from ...'), 2 are recurring dance/art classes (own h4 text states 'Class Runs from ...'), and 1 ('Word Space') is an ambiguous spoken-word/open-mic night conservatively excluded. Fully answers the question with no browser escalation required.

Coordinates independently confirmed via real OSM_ID_LOOKUP (OSM itself independently tags this node type=music_venue) and verified to fall within the existing United Kingdom map view bounds with zero frontend change required.
No unresolved CRITICAL or MINOR blocker remains.
